items.title: Champions
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Every story has its champion. All challenges the champion must endure along their journey forms them into the character they are destined to be. Their background may vary but their story remains constant. They are overcomers forged in the uncertainty of the future for the desire of a better tomorrow. Be the champion of your story.

items.title: Dino Fashion
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Rawr! You'll find the coolest and cutest Dino skins you've ever seen in this pack! Equip these awesome dinosaur skins now and grab the attention of all your friends!

+ 16 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Dinosaur themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Mob Super Stars

items.description:
Shine among the classic mobs! These super skins were made for fun role-playing times.

- 12 epic mob super star skins!
- 2 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.title: Axolotl Fashion
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
With your new axolotl style, you will impress all players with your sweetness.

- 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Rvan Studios

items.description:
Punk Teen Fashion is seizing the fashion industry! Rule the runway shows and be among the influencers!

- 20 cool skins
- 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Giant House
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: Living like an ant sounds fun, but it's tough to challenge all the giant animals and environmental hazards like lava and rain. However on this map you will explore a house built by a giant family. Lots of places to explore and tons of easter eggs to find!

items.title: Gamers!
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Put on your headset and game on in style!

+ 10 teenage skins
+ 2 FREE skins!

items.title: Pastel Rainbow Teens
items.creator: Duh
items.description:
Check out the pastel rainbow skins! 

- 21 pastel skins

items.title: Mini Mobs 2
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: So cute and so mini, these mob skins are perfectly pint sized! You can pick the mini Creeper, Enderman or Ghast! There are five adorable mini mob options for you to choose from!

items.title: Craftable Helicopters
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Craft and fly helicopters anywhere! Roleplay as a fireman or policeman and protect the city. Late for work? No need for cars and elevators. Fly your helicopter to the very top of the skyscraper and make it just in time. Or, just explore the infinite world in style.
- 8 new crafting recipes
- 7 craftable helicopters and 1 plane
- 5 skins
- Large city

Up, up, and away!

items.title: Mountain Bikes
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Bike down dangerous mountain trails! Ride fast and leap over terrifying gaps. Miss a jump and you're back to the last checkpoint. Parkour through the rings to earn points. Earn trophies by getting a perfect score.
- 12 tracks
- 6 unique track themes
- Easy and hardcore modes
- 5 bike types

Pop a wheelie over lava!

items.title: Ultimate Weapons
items.creator: Tsunami Studios
items.description:
Tired of your friends owning you in PvP? Tired of hiding from zombies? Well, that ends NOW! Take back your reign with an all-new set of ridiculously over powered sci-fi weapons! 

15 unique weapons? Check. 
Tons of blasters? Yes. 
Multiplayer friendly? You betcha. 
All craftable? Absolutely. 
A giant mech suit that fires las.... Maybe you should just watch the trailer.

items.title: Miner Town
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: An ancient mine where a civilization created their own village, explore it's secrets and treasures, adventure yourself in the deepest parts from the rocks and caves around.

items.title: Popstar Roleplay
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description:
They are back in town! be a pop star and impress your friends,
Music is the best way to free the city of boredom and spread the joy!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 popstar friends
+ By Lune & GearBlocks

items.title: Ultra Armor
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Ultra Powerful Armor for your adventures! Check out these awesome neon outfits!

- 8 Armor skins
- Perfect for roleplay
- By KA Studios

items.title: Anime Legends
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Ever wanted to be a legend and look good while being one? Dream no more! With this trendy, yet cute anime skin pack you will transform into a hero of your own story! Want to be a villain and wear dark clothes? Or maybe a fancy and colorful hero? There is something for everyone!

- 12 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Pets HD
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Hatch, raise, and evolve custom pets! Complete the story, loot dungeons, and get money to buy pet eggs. Each pet has a unique ability! Soar the skies on a dragon, defeat bandits with your robot t-rex and free trapped pets from hidden dungeons!
+Over 125 animated pets
+4 stages per pet
+Expansive world with secrets and quests
+Custom sounds and music
+Custom furniture

items.title: ECD Monsters
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Experiment, classified, destroyed - this is a creed of paranormal events secret researching foundation. Every member of an organization utilized for specific purposes in order to keep the world safe from horrors. Choose your character and join the game either as a protector or as a scary monster.

+ Monsters
+ Scary
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Medics
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These medics are ready to help anyone in need! First build the hospital, and then get to work!

- 8 medic skins!
- Roleplay as a doctor, nurse, or surgeon!

items.title: Teens in Fame
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Flashing lights, big city, and fame! Get ready to be one of the most famous teens in the city. You can be a movie star, singer or either whatever you want. Just dress up and show up in your mansion with your friends.

- 10 skins
- by Withercore

items.title: Maids
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These maid outfits are looking fancy! Pick from a wide selection of uniforms and then get to work!

- 8 skins!
- Pick from many different uniform designs!

items.title: Dragon Ninjas
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Which is more terrifying, a dragon or a ninja? Well, now you don't have to decide! Combine the two and become one of the most powerful creatures in the world! With the Dragon Ninjas skin pack, not even an Enderman would come near you!

- 6 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Retro Game Teens
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Why does everything look so green? Take a step into the past, way before Creepers knew how to explode, and become a Retro Game Teen! What's better than a peek into the past?
